test_RaycastTest_test_pickup_raycast: test the RaycastTest class and its test_pickup_raycast method which verifies raycast observations when picking up apples
test_deepmind_lab_Lab: test the deepmind_lab.Lab class to create a raycast-enabled environment with RAYCASTS and DEBUG.POS.TRANS observation channels
test_env_action_spec: test the env.action_spec() method to retrieve available actions and build an action index mapping action names to indices
test_env_reset_step: test the env.reset() and env.step() methods to interact with the environment and collect rewards from raycast observations
test_env_observations_RAYCASTS: test the env.observations()['RAYCASTS'] access pattern to read raycast hit values for verifying object pickup events
